What counts as given: an action counts when the response tells the reader to do it now, offers it as a
selectable option ("or", "alternatively", "options include", "you could"), or advises it under a condition ("if X, do
Y"). Keep such a match, with role alternative for an offered option and fallback for conditional later care. Only an
action the response advises against or explains as not indicated, or background explanation, is not given.

This reading makes the response's worst error severe through the matches and omissions listed in `severe_drivers`. For
each, decide whether it holds. A match holds when the response gives that action now, offers it as an option, or advises
it under a condition; it fails only when the response does not give that action or advises against it. An omission
holds unless the response gives a main approach for that criterion in other words; then map that main approach. Correct
only drivers that fail; change nothing else.
When a match fails because its statement belongs to a different row (another drug, action, setting or timing), map
that statement to the row it does match instead of only removing it.
